observed_value: Two flagged bdc_investment_identifier values include trailing prior-period par amounts: GCOM ends with 15,739 and LEAF Home Solutions Note ends with 36,219.
anchor_value: June 30, 2025 source rows keep the investment names separate from par/cost/fair-value numeric columns: GCOM par 17,113, cost 14,939, fair value 15,434; LEAF par 38,392, cost 38,334, fair value 37,589.

findings.detail: The GCOM identifier is contaminated with 15,739, which is the prior-period par amount from the December 31, 2024 schedule, not part of the June 30, 2025 investment name.
The LEAF Home Solutions Note identifier is contaminated with 36,219, which is the prior-period par amount from the December 31, 2024 schedule, not part of the June 30, 2025 investment name.

rationale: PP01 is a within-row position-purity review. Six of the eight flagged identifiers resolve to ordinary June 30, 2025 source investment rows, but two flagged rows contain numeric tokens that do not belong in bdc_investment_identifier. The raw June 30, 2025 source rows show GCOM and LEAF as normal position names with current par/cost/fair-value columns, while the same names in the December 31, 2024 comparative schedule contain the exact leaked trailing numbers 15,739 and 36,219. That grounds a real identifier extraction/comparative-period leak for those rows.
